decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - That the London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby 
certify that on 06/04/05, the erection of a roof extension to dwelling house with dormer measuring 3.6m projection, 2.48m high, 5.3m wide and hip to gable measuring 3.6m long, 2.48m high and 8.1m wide, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 and therefore does not require planning permission for the following reason:

The proposed extension does not exceed 50 cubic metres and falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1 Class B of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.


INFORMATIVE
If you receive planning permission for your proposed ground floor extension (reference 01047/75/P1), and work on it commences before the loft extension subject to this decision is completed, this will invalidate the lawful development certificate for the loft extension.  As a result your client will be liable to enforcement action which may threaten any loan secured against the property and may result in prosecution attracting a fine, if successful, not exceeding ?20000.  It is likely also to make the property difficult to sell.
description: Certificate for lawfulness for the proposed erection of side and rear roof extensions to house.
